dispatch_text_to_speech: dispatch an AWS Polly text-to-speech request with voice, format, and speed parameters
map_openai_params: map OpenAI TTS parameters to AWS Polly SynthesizeSpeech API parameters
transform_text_to_speech_request: transform an OpenAI TTS request into a signed AWS Polly SynthesizeSpeech request
transform_text_to_speech_response: transform an AWS Polly audio response into a standard HttpxBinaryResponseContent
validate_environment: validate AWS environment credentials and set up request headers for Polly API calls
